title: capture: Pass --no-optimize to dumpcap
description:
This allows --no-optimize to work from the command line for Wireshark
and tshark for capturing on interfaces (the previous commit enabled
dumpcap support). GUI support from Wireshark, compiled filter support,
and extcap support will come shortly.

Ping #18190

changes_data.diff:
@@ -451,6 +451,16 @@ List the data link types supported by the interface and exit.
 List time stamp types supported for the interface. If no time stamp type can be
 set, no time stamp types are listed.
 
+--no-optimize::
+Do not run the libpcap optimizer when generating code for a capture filter.
+This is useful if you suspect a bug in the optimizer, or for instructive
+purposes.
+
+This option can occur multiple times. If used before the first
+occurrence of the *-i* option, capture filters are not optimized for all
+interfaces. If used after an *-i* option, the capture filter for the interface
+specified by the last *-i* option occurring before this option is not optimized.
+
 -o  <preference/recent setting>::
 +
 --
